title: Taisen
tagline: Compete, Win, Get paid Repeat! Your TCG Tournament platform, on-chain.
description:
Welcome to Taisen! 🎴✨ Your decentralized arena for Trading Card Game glory! 🏆

Built with love on the Sui blockchain 💧, Taisen makes tournament magic happen without the stress. 🪄 Whether you're a Pokémon Master 🐭⚡, a legendary Planeswalker 🪄✨, or a King of Games 🐉🎴, this is where you turn your deck into a legacy!

Why you'll love it:

Trustless Prize Pools 💰: Our smart contracts (written in Move!) ensure the winner takes the spoils, no questions asked!
Cyber Aesthetic 🌐: A sleek, futuristic UI that feels as premium as a first-edition holofoil.
For Everyone 👋: Whether you’re a Game Master hosting the next big regional or a Player looking for a local scrap, we’ve got you covered!
Ready to draw your hand? Join the Taisen community and let’s battle! 🃏🚀✨

how_its_made:
🌐 The Frontend (The Command Center)
Nuxt 4 (Vue 3): Our core engine! It gives us that blazing-fast, SEO-friendly performance that keeps the UI feeling snappy. ⚡️
Tailwind CSS v4: The ultimate toolkit for our futuristic, cyber-themed design. Modern, sleek, and developer-friendly! 🎨✨
shadcn-vue: For those premium, accessible UI components (buttons, cards, modals) that make the app feel like a Triple-A title. 💎
⛓️ The Blockchain (The Vault)
Sui Network: The high-speed L1 where all the tournament magic happens. Instant finality and low fees! 💧🌊
Move Language: The safe and powerful language used for our smart contracts (check them out in the /move folder!). 🛡️📦
@mysten/sui: The official SDK we use to talk to the blockchain from the frontend. 📡
🛠️ The Utilities (The Secret Sauce)
VueUse: A collection of amazing Vue composition utilities that handle everything from local storage to window resizing. 🧰
Lucide Vue: For all those crisp, beautiful icons you see throughout the app. 🕵️‍♂️✨
Vitest: Keeping our code bulletproof with fast, reliable testing. 🧪🧤
pnpm: Our lightning-fast package manager of choice. 📦🚀
